title: Pricing model
hook: Pure consumption pricing — and you don't pay while the agent waits on the model or an API.

back.lead: Every AgentCore service is pay-as-you-go with no upfront commitment or minimums. The headline economic feature: Runtime, Browser, and Code Interpreter bill per-second on active CPU/memory only — and {{slot:io_wait_share}}.

kv.v: Billed on event/data volume; short and long term priced separately.
Direct-code deploys billed at S3 rates; container deploys at ECR rates; browser profiles at S3 rates.

back.hookline: An agent that 'thinks' for 60s but computes for 6s bills roughly like 6s — that's the whole pitch vs. always-on containers.

compute_price.template: Per-second vCPU + memory for Runtime / Browser / Code Interpreter, on active consumption only — {{fact:agentcore.pricing.ap-southeast-2.runtime.vcpu.usd-per-vcpu-hour}} per vCPU-hour and {{fact:agentcore.pricing.ap-southeast-2.runtime.memory.usd-per-gb-hour}} per GB-hour in Asia Pacific (Sydney).
compute_price.rendered: Per-second vCPU + memory for Runtime / Browser / Code Interpreter, on active consumption only — $0.0895 per vCPU-hour and $0.00945 per GB-hour in Asia Pacific (Sydney).
compute_price.seed_text: Per-second CPU + memory for Runtime / Browser / Code Interpreter (active consumption only).

gateway_price.template: Per tool invocation — {{fact:agentcore.pricing.ap-southeast-2.gateway.api-invocations.usd-per-1k}} per 1,000 API invocations in Asia Pacific (Sydney) — plus tool-indexing and data-processing charges.
gateway_price.rendered: Per tool invocation — $0.005 per 1,000 API invocations in Asia Pacific (Sydney) — plus tool-indexing and data-processing charges.
gateway_price.seed_text: Per tool invocation (launched around $0.005 per 1,000 calls) plus request charges.

history.reason: Card asserted that agentic workloads "typically spend 30–70% of wall-clock time in I/O wait". No AWS source publishes that figure and none could: it describes a customer workload, not the service. The quantity is removed; the qualitative point it supported is retained and is quantified concretely by the card’s hookline instead.
